description: Modular layers extracted from the farmyard background. Each layer holds one visual group so elements can be moved, hidden, or replaced independently in Godot.

layers.name: Sky
layers.purpose: Sky gradient and clouds. Transparent below the horizon so it cannot tint farm art if reordered.

layers.name: GroundBase
layers.purpose: Main grass ground with opaque meadow/hill shapes, the continuous rear farm fence, and opaque pre-blended activity-area floor pads.

layers.name: Paths
layers.purpose: Dirt paths connecting activity areas across the farmyard.

layers.name: DecorativeProps
layers.purpose: Non-essential decorative props: trees, bushes, hay bales, small flowers. Not tied to any single activity area.

layers.name: ActivityBackFence
layers.purpose: Shared back-fence artwork for the chicken, feeding, and brushing activity areas. Kept as one full-canvas layer so it aligns at position (0, 0).

layers.name: CowArea
layers.purpose: Cow milking area art: barn-red roof frame over a stall nook.

layers.name: GardenArea
layers.purpose: Garden care area art: soil bed rows with sprout plants and a watering can.

notes: Base layers are 1600x900 full-canvas PNGs so they stack seamlessly in the mobile package. They preserve the original 1920x1080 safe composition proportionally.
Set Sprite2D at position (0,0) with no offset for correct alignment.
Activity area layers (z_index 4) can be moved by adjusting the Sprite2D node position in Godot.
The original farmyard_background.png remains untouched for reference.
Existing activity area Area2D nodes (with collision + labels) sit at z_index 10+.
The scene's existing Icon sprites under each Area2D provide the tappable-area visuals; the background layers provide the ground-level environment art.
